text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The new programme of Mozambique's ruling Frelimo party, being discussed at a party congress this week, maintains the principle that all land is state property, and that land titles should protect the rights of Mozambican citizens who occupy and use the land.

- Thieves have stolen nearly 26,000 metres of electricity cable, most of it copper, in the southern Mozambican province of Maputo since the beginning of this year. Cable stolen in Moza-bique is believed to be sold in South Africa and other neighbouring countries.
